blocks.text: Big-serving Alexander Zverev trounced home hopeful Shang Juncheng 6-0, 6-3 at the China Open on Saturday to set up a quarterfinal clash with Novak Djokovic. The German top seed needed just 55 minutes to brush aside the Chinese wildcard, ranked 250th, firing nine aces along the way. “Happy with the win,” the world’s second-ranked player said, adding that his 21-year-old opponent had been “dangerous” and had “nothing to lose.” READ: Alexander Zverev beats home bet Ben Shelton to win US Open title “Looking forward to the next couple of weeks,” Zverev said ahead of his tie with Djokovic — who has […]...
